# InfiniVerde Ltd
> Closed-source quantitative research across 30+ UK and European built environment markets.

## About
InfiniVerde Ltd operates closed-source research infrastructure across 30+ UK and European markets in the built environment. Quantitative research division of REinfinite Group Ltd, a quantitative real estate firm. Every model, pipeline, and decision framework built internally.

## Research Coverage
Sovereign yield trajectories, monetary policy signals, trade flows, currency dynamics, local planning intelligence, ESG benchmarking. Initial screening through ongoing asset monitoring.

## Research Access
Closed-source. Not licensed or made available externally.

## Philosophy
Every model, every data pipeline, every decision framework built internally from first principles. The system was designed to identify what off-the-shelf platforms cannot.

## How to Engage
Research enquiries: https://infiniverde.com/. Research is closed-source and not licensed externally.
